rows.caption:
Pharmacist Led Walk-In Clinic and Senior's Day today!

Our Rxtra Care Walk-In Clinic is running all day today from 9 AM to 6 PM, and our pharmacists are ready to help!

Whether it's a flu or COVID shot, a minor ailment, a blood pressure check, or a medication review, we're happy to take the time to look after you. No appointment needed!

 And don't forget, it's Seniors Day!

Every Wednesday, our customers aged 65 and older enjoy 20% off regular-priced items in our front store. Just a little way for us to show our appreciation!

Whether you're stopping in for care, picking up a prescription, or just saying hello, it's always nice to see you.

Have a wonderful Wednesday from all of us at Seaside Pharmacy!

rows.caption:
CALLING ALL CONTRACTORS!

Whether you've been working with us for years, are new to Main Street Home Hardware, or haven't had the chance to work with us yet, you're invited!

Join us for our Contractor Information Night on Thursday, October 22!

We'll be welcoming two industry representatives:
Cherry Seely from Regal Ideas
Scott Kennedy from Kennedy Metals

This is your opportunity to connect directly with the reps, learn more about their products, explore what's available, get some insider industry knowledge, and ask the questions that matter to you and your projects.

 Thursday, October 22

 Main Street Home Hardware, Souris

 6:00 PM | Pizza & refreshments (non-alcoholic)

️ 6:30 PM | Presentations begin

There's no cost to attend, and everyone in the contracting and trades community is welcome!

We're looking forward to an evening of good food, useful information, and connecting with the people who keep our local construction industry moving.

 Planning to join us? Email to RSVP at stephanie@mepei.ca

 We'd love to have an idea of numbers so we can make sure there's plenty of pizza to go around.

See you Thursday!

rows.caption:
Join our Youth Art Show at the Cornwall Public Library!

The annual Cornwall Library Youth Art Show runs during December. Any young artists are welcome to submit a piece of visual art to our group show. Deadline for dropping off your piece is Friday, November 27 at 5:00 p.m.

You may submit any single item you would like to include, which has NOT previously been exhibited in the gallery. Picture frames are not required, but any canvas or frame MUST have two eye-hooks and a wire on the back.  Contact the library for details at 902-629-8415.

The show will run the entire month of December during open library hours.  

Meet the artists on Tuesday, December 1 at 7:00 p.m.

#peilibrary Town of Cornwall PEI
